for: The presentation: why a lap that a clinging plant reaches is cut differently. Not placed in the deck yet.
shows: One lap of the roof, drawn large from the two members as Blender mills them, with the view turning. The drawing comes in from the whole room to the lap. An ivy stem creeps along one member to the crossing; the member lifts out to show the gap beside it, and the stem goes in; the stem thickens and the lap is forced; the lap is milled open where the stem lies; the stem grows again and has room; and the drawing goes back out to the room, with the laps cut this way marked.
statement: Schematic. The members and both cuts are the building model's own. That a stem in a gap forces it is general knowledge of clinging plants, not something the plant simulator shows.
